target_customer: Retail investors in Latin America who want access to US stocks, ETFs and crypto
problem: Latin Americans face high minimums, fees and local market limits when buying US stocks. Hapi offers commission-free, no-minimum investing through a US registered broker-dealer.
business_model: Consumer brokerage: revenue from margin lending, payment flow, crypto spreads and premium features (company states no commissions)

founders.name: Dusko Kelez
education: Bachelor in Economic Sciences, Pacific University
Computer science studies for business professionals, Harvard

founders.name: Billy Caballero
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no further background.

founders.name: Piero Sifuentes
founders.background_notes: YC page lists both Caballero and Sifuentes as CTO; Contxto says the venture was started in October 2020 by Kelez, Sifuentes and Caballero.

competitors.name: Flink
competitors.what: Mexican commission-free investing app offering US ETFs and later US stocks
competitors.traction_then: Waitlist of hundreds of thousands for US stock access (684,000 per a later summary)

competitors.name: Stake
competitors.what: Australian app that expanded to Brazil for US stock access

competitors.name: Vest
competitors.what: Startup giving Latin Americans access to US equities

technical_complexity.rationale: Consumer app on top of Apex clearing and a US broker-dealer registration; mostly standard engineering with compliance and KYC across many countries.

defensibility.rationale: Broker-dealer registration helps but competitors used partners like Alpaca and DriveWealth; consumer acquisition drives the business.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Webull bought rival Flink (date not in sources opened); no sign of an incumbent buying Hapi.

market_need_then: Retail trading boomed in early 2021 and Latin Americans had limited access to US markets; Flink's waitlist suggests demand.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain, consumer friendly; no minimums and no commissions

branding.brand_signature: Robinhood for Latin America framing in press
branding.community_and_virality: Press mentions a NASDAQ tower celebration at 500,000 customers (Ecosistema Startup headline).

brand_strength.rationale: Regional press coverage and over 500,000 customers by mid 2024 per Contxto, and company site claims 1.3 million users; name origin not found.

outcome_analysis: Hapi stayed active and grew to over 500,000 customers by mid 2024 with raises of about 2.7 million after YC and 1.6 million in November 2023. The CEO says it has positive cash flow, which fits capital efficient growth in a booming retail trading market. Its company site claims 1.3 million users and 19 countries, but that figure is self reported.
notes: The 2.7M round is dated only as post YC (2021) per Forbes Colombia; the stage is not stated. Contxto 2024 interview says total raised 4.3M. The 1.6M round is stated by Contxto and LatamList. Competitor source dates are not shown in the pages opened; sources may be later than founding.
